summary: Pivot from historical averages to reactive: book only trip classes with positive catches in last 3 days.
describe: Reactive strategy: sums yellowtail caught fleet-wide over last 3 fished days per class. Books any available trip (HD_PM, THREE_QUARTER, OVERNIGHT, DAY_1_5) when its class is hot (sum > 0 in recent days). Prioritizes classes with more recent catch. Fits bookings within remaining budget and PTO. No pre-committed PTO; twilight and weekends are free.
